hot.title: From AGI to ASI
hot.summary: Researchers at Google DeepMind establish an analytical framework to map the potential evolution of artificial intelligence from AGI to ASI, outlining four technological pathways and six specific bottlenecks. The work provides a research agenda for predicting and managing the development of advanced AI capabilities.

hot.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
hot.summary: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) offers an efficient, blockwise sparse attention mechanism for large language models, significantly reducing computational cost for ultra-long contexts. It maintains model performance across diverse tasks while achieving notable speedups, such as a 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding speedup at 1M context on H800 GPUs, driven by a 28.4x reduction in attention FLOPs.

hot.title: Unsafe AI or Consolidated Power: AI’s False Dichotomy
Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
hot.summary: HyVLA-0.5, a comprehensive robot learning stack from Tencent Robotics X and Tencent Hy Team, unifies high-fidelity data collection, VLM-based training, preference-driven policy refinement, and real-world deployment for generalist robots. The system achieved 90.9% success on clean simulated tasks and demonstrated effective cross-embodiment transfer and robust policy improvement via reward-free post-training on real robots.

hot.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
hot.summary: HarnessX is a framework for building composable, adaptive, and evolvable AI agent harnesses that achieved an average absolute gain of +14.5% in agent performance across various configurations. It enables agents to systematically learn and improve their runtime interfaces from execution feedback, including co-evolving with the underlying language model to internalize new strategies.

hot.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
hot.summary: Researchers from Nanjing University and Alibaba Group investigated the parameter updates of On-Policy Distillation (OPD), revealing that it induces small, sparse, and spectrally concentrated modifications to model weights, primarily affecting off-principal directions. These findings indicate that OPD's on-policy data distribution drives a localized "editing" style of parameter refinement, distinct from dense supervised approaches.

hot.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
hot.summary: RepFusion introduces a text-to-image (T2I) generation framework that leverages a frozen, pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to actively denoise in representation space by dynamically processing evolving noisy visual representations. This method enhances T2I performance and achieves parameter efficiency by utilizing the MLLM's strong multimodal priors for adaptive conditioning.

hot.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
hot.summary: This research introduces EvoArena, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate Large Language Model (LLM) agents in continually evolving environments, alongside EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that explicitly tracks memory evolution. EvoMem consistently enhances agent robustness in dynamic settings, yielding improvements of up to 6.1% in chain-level accuracy on the new benchmark and significantly reducing regressions in software engineering tasks.

hot.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
hot.summary: WAM4D enhances robot world action models by efficiently incorporating 4D geometric priors via training-time spatial register tokens, which are removed during inference to maintain computational efficiency. It achieved a 90% real-world sub-action success rate and an average 91.8% success rate in simulation across challenging manipulation tasks.

hot.title: Can I Buy Your KV Cache?
hot.summary: Researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, introduced a "prefill CDN" model, demonstrating that reusing precomputed Key-Value caches for shared document prefixes in Large Language Models is token-exact. This approach achieved 9-50x compute cost savings for repeated document access, offering substantial efficiency gains for long-context applications.

hot.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
hot.summary: World Tracing, developed by World Labs and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, presents a generative pixel-aligned multilayer 3D geometry representation. It reconstructs visible surfaces and completes occluded 3D geometry from 2D inputs, showing improved accuracy on visible surfaces and comprehensive geometry generation for objects, scenes, and dynamic content while supporting various downstream 3D applications.

hot.title: First Steps Toward Automated AI Research
μ0μ_0μ0​: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
hot.summary: A new scalable 3D interaction-trace world model, μ0, learns to predict future motions of semantic interaction points from diverse video data, significantly reducing reliance on action-labeled robot datasets. The model demonstrates superior multi-sample trace prediction quality and enables robot policies to achieve up to an 18.4 percentage-point higher success rate in real-world manipulation tasks than VLM-only baselines.

hot.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
hot.summary: EUREKAGENT introduces an agent environment engineering paradigm that coordinates off-the-shelf LLM-based CLI agents for autonomous scientific discovery, emphasizing external environmental design over prescriptive workflows. The system achieved new state-of-the-art results across mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks through structured permissions, artifacts, budgets, and human-in-the-loop interfaces.

hot.title: LLM Agents Can See Code Repositories
hot.summary: Researchers from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and collaborators introduce SeeRepo, a multimodal framework enabling LLM agents to visually perceive code repository structures for software engineering tasks. This hybrid approach integrates visual graphs of repository dependencies with textual code, leading to substantial reductions in token consumption by up to 46% and maintaining or improving issue-resolution accuracy across various MLLMs, particularly when visual context is utilized during fault localization.

hot.title: Gaze Heads: How VLMs Look at What They Describe
hot.summary: Gandikota and Bau identify "gaze heads" in vision-language models, a specific subset of attention heads that dynamically focus on image regions as the model generates descriptive text. Intervening on these heads causally steers the model's visual grounding with up to 83.1% redirection accuracy, and this mechanism generalizes across various VLM architectures but is largely absent in models with frozen vision encoders.

hot.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
hot.summary: Researchers from Nanjing University and CASIA developed OmniVideo-100K, an automated data synthesis engine that generates 100,000 high-quality instruction-tuning audio-visual question-answer pairs for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The dataset, built through entity-anchored video scripting and clue-guided QA generation, improved MLLM performance on complex audio-visual reasoning tasks by up to 20.59% on a human-verified test set, demonstrating enhanced cross-modal comprehension and long-term temporal reasoning.

hot.title: From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: The Paradigm Shift Toward Persistent Autonomous AI
hot.summary: Researchers from Tencent Youtu Lab and collaborating universities propose a two-dimensional framework that categorizes the evolution of Large Language Models from simple chatbots to "Digital Colleagues," autonomous AI systems capable of persistent, reliable work. This framework emphasizes how advancements in cognitive core and tool-augmented task execution, particularly through a "Workspace + Skill" paradigm, transform LLMs for complex, end-to-end task completion, necessitating new data and evaluation approaches.

hot.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
Instruct-Particulate: Scaling Feed-Forward 3D Object Articulation with Kinematic Control
hot.summary: Researchers from the University of Oxford and University of Cambridge developed INSTRUCT-PARTICULATE, a framework that scales 3D articulated object understanding by leveraging a large, diverse dataset constructed through VLM-based pseudo-labeling and integrating explicit kinematic specifications as input. The method demonstrates improved part segmentation and joint motion parameter prediction, even for novel and AI-generated objects, significantly outperforming existing baselines.

likes.title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
likes.summary: Researchers from UC Berkeley and Physical Intelligence introduce QGF (Q-Guided Flow), a reinforcement learning algorithm that achieves policy optimization entirely at test time. This method guides a pre-trained flow policy using gradients from a learned Q-function, demonstrating performance competitive with or superior to state-of-the-art training-time RL methods on continuous control tasks, while improving computational efficiency compared to Best-of-N sampling.

likes.title: ICA Lens: Interpreting Language Models Without Training Another Dictionary
likes.summary: Researchers Sida Liu and Feijiang Han introduced ICALens, a workflow that makes Independent Component Analysis practical and efficient for interpreting large language model activations. The method recovers human-interpretable features with high non-Gaussianity and demonstrates competitive utility in sparse probing and targeted probe perturbation tasks compared to existing methods like PCA and some sparse autoencoder variants.

likes.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
likes.summary: An AI framework named Arbor enables autonomous research by organizing hypotheses, experimental evidence, and insights into a persistent tree structure. This approach allows agents to manage long-horizon scientific tasks and iteratively improve research artifacts more effectively than existing methods.

likes.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
likes.summary: Kuaishou Group's Keye Team developed Kwai Keye-VL-2.0, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed for understanding ultra-long video contexts and enhancing agentic intelligence. The model addresses extreme context scaling and catastrophic forgetting through sparse attention and multi-teacher distillation, achieving leading performance in temporal localization and strong results in various agent tasks.

likes.title: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
likes.summary: Bebop, developed by Alibaba's Qwen Team, accelerates large language model reinforcement learning training by enhancing Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) efficiency. It addresses MTP acceptance rate degradation by identifying target model entropy as the dominant factor and introduces an end-to-end Total Variation loss and a pre-RL adaptation strategy, achieving up to 1.8x end-to-end training acceleration.

likes.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
likes.summary: Next Forcing introduces a multi-chunk prediction framework to enhance causal world models by providing denser temporal supervision, addressing the issue of myopic supervision. It achieves new state-of-the-art performance on robot manipulation tasks, accelerates training by up to 2.3x, and enables 2x inference speedup while improving physical dynamics understanding and general video generation quality.

likes.title: RLCSD: Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
likes.summary: RLCSD (Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation) enhances the training of large reasoning models by mitigating "privilege-induced style drift" in on-policy self-distillation. The method achieves this by generating a contrastive, task-focused token-level learning signal that is robustly integrated with outcome-level rewards, leading to improved performance and stability on various reasoning tasks.

likes.title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
likes.summary: MiniMax developed MaxProof, a framework that significantly improves large language models' capabilities in generating competition-level mathematical proofs. This is achieved by integrating a multi-stage trained M3 model, which can generate, verify, and refine proofs, with a population-level test-time scaling method that iteratively evolves and selects solutions. MaxProof enabled the M3 model to surpass human gold-medal thresholds on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026, boosting its one-shot scores by 8 and 10 points, respectively.

likes.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Shared Context
likes.summary: A decentralized multi-agent system framework, DELM, leverages a shared and verified context to improve the scalability, efficiency, and reliability of LLM reasoning. The system achieved up to 10.5 percentage points higher success rates in software engineering tasks with approximately 50% reduced costs, and demonstrated superior accuracy in multi-document question answering.

likes.title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
likes.summary: A unified framework named TRACE was developed by researchers at Tsinghua University and Tencent to efficiently allocate rollout budgets in multi-turn agentic Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). This framework improves learning signals by strategically exploring prompt roots and intermediate prefixes predicted to generate both successful and failed outcomes, resulting in consistent accuracy gains (e.g., 2.8 points on Multi-Hop QA) and a significantly increased proportion of informative training rollouts.

likes.title: Anatomy of Post-Training: Using Interpretability to Characterize Data and Shape the Learning Signal
likes.summary: Researchers introduced a data-centric post-training pipeline for large language models that uses neural network interpretability to audit preference datasets and sculpt the learning signal. This approach effectively diagnosed problematic data patterns in datasets like Dolci, mitigated undesirable stylistic attributes such as over-stylization, and enhanced model safeguards against harmful queries.

likes.title: i1: A Simple and Fully Open Recipe for Strong Text-to-Image Models
likes.summary: Princeton University researchers systematically investigated over 300 design choices for text-to-image models, leading to i1, a fully open-source model that outperforms previous fully open models by an average of 29.5 absolute percentage points and competes with larger open-weight models.
